remainingLimitations: Official initialize-only02 passed protocol1 and advertised onlygrok.com; no actual cached-auth success or model readiness is claimed.
Official CLI cached_token may refresh/fall through to login after loss/expiry. headless:true is not no-login assurance. This patch does not modify profiles or eliminate that CLI behavior.
User must explicitly authorize/login a dedicated official private profile for future authenticated/model acceptance.
Only selected ACP+Host suites246 were run here; other package suites/browser/native belong to the shared final acceptance queue.
